```python
def canonical_url(url):
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        raise ValueError("URL must be a string")
    
    lower = url.lower()
    if not (lower.startswith("http://") or lower.startswith("https://")):
        raise ValueError("Only http/https URLs are allowed")
    
    # Scheme
    if lower.startswith("https://"):
        scheme = "https"
    else:
        scheme = "http"
    
    rest = url[len(scheme) + 3:]  # remove "http://" or "https://"
    
    # Find fragment
    frag_idx = rest.find('#')
    if frag_idx != -1:
        rest = rest[:frag_idx]
    
    # Find query
    query_idx = rest.find('?')
    path = rest[:query_idx] if query_idx != -1 else rest
    query = rest[query_idx:] if query_idx != -1 else ""
    
    # Host: up to first '/'
    slash_idx = path.find('/')
    if slash_idx == -1:
        host = path
        host_part = ""
    else:
        host = path[:slash_idx]
        host_part = path[slash_idx:]
    
    if not host:
        raise ValueError("Missing host")
    
    scheme = scheme  # already lowercase
    
    # Reconstruct
    result = scheme + "://" + host.lower() + host_part
    if query:
        result += query
    return result
```
